provenance.source: P13-v4.2 observer recipe (accepted) with the state-block addresses corrected from the FW13.52 kernel image
provenance.note: the pup_update state block is the static 0x50 byte object at RVA 0x2684810 (its address is cdev->si_drv1); the window pointers are state+0x30 -> RVA 0x2684840 and state+0x38 -> RVA 0x2684848, written by the driver attach (0x637537 sets window A to RVA 0x2688000, 0x63753e passes &window_B to the service init) and NULLed by the detach (0x637578/0x63758f). No code in the image references the 0x2686xxx page, which is why v2 could only ever read zero. No window backing buffer is read by absolute RVA: window bytes come only from the root chain.

entries.name: CDEV_SLOT
entries.role: resolved authority (cdev pointer); its own address is state+0x00

entries.name: SOFTC_A_ROOT
entries.role: resolved authority (window A pointer = state+0x30) or 0

entries.name: SOFTC_B_ROOT
entries.role: resolved authority (window B pointer = state+0x38) or 0
